Backed by GV, Kleiner Perkins, M12, Telstra Ventures, and Sorenson Capital, it serves Fortune 500 firms including Broadcom, Vitamix, Equinix, and Credit Suisse to handle complex datasets in real time. * * * #### Founded 2013 #### HQ ![United States](https://flagcdn.com/w40/us.png)San Francisco, CA #### Website [incorta.com](http://www.incorta.com/) #### Status Privately held #### Customer focus B2B #### Revenue model Subscription #### Valuation $8M (Sep 2015) #### Sectors [BI & Analytics Software](https://multiples.vc/bi-analytics-software-valuation-multiples) [Data Infrastructure](https://multiples.vc/data-infrastructure-valuation-multiples) [B2B SaaS](https://multiples.vc/b2b-saas-valuation-multiples) [Horizontal SaaS](https://multiples.vc/horizontal-saas-valuation-multiples) ### Incorta Valuation Incorta is currently valued at $8M, based on its seed round in September 2015. #### Incorta valuation by funding round | Date | Stage | Valuation | | --- | --- | --- | | Sep 2015 | Seed | $8M | Incorta valuation by funding round ### Incorta Funding History Incorta has raised a total of $192M across 6 funding rounds. Incorta's first fundraising round was a $2M seed round in September 2015. The most recent completed round was a $120M Series D in June 2021. #### Incorta funding rounds | Date | Stage | Investors | Raised | Valuation | Deal Summary | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Jun 2021 | Series D | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.prysmcapital.com&size=64)Prysm Capital,![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kleinerperkins.com&size=64)Kleiner Perkins +8Prysm Capital (lead); Kleiner Perkins; GV; Titanium Ventures; National Grid; Sorenson Capital; M12; Silicon Valley Bank; Ron Wohl; Wipro Ventures | $120M | - | Incorta is a data analytics startup offering an all-in-one p…Incorta is a data analytics startup offering an all-in-one platform that simplifies data processing by combining extract, transform, and load (ETL) steps into a single process, enabling customers to analyze corporate data across multiple databases and visualize it in charts and graphics.
The company raised $120 million in a Series D funding round on June 23, 2021, led by Prysm Capital, with participation from GV (Google Ventures), M12 (Microsoft's venture arm), Kleiner Perkins, National Grid Partners, Sorenson Capital, Ron Wohl, Titanium Ventures, and others, bringing total funding to $195 million across 10 rounds.
Incorta's customers include Broadcom, Redstone Credit Union, Genworth Financial, and Stanford University, positioning it to compete with giants like Oracle, SAP, and Tableau, as well as potential entrants from cloud providers like Amazon, Microsoft, and Snowflake. The funding aims to fuel expansion and competition in the business analytics space. | | Aug 2019 | Series C | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sorensoncapital.com&size=64)Sorenson Capital,![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kleinerperkins.com&size=64)Kleiner Perkins +4Sorenson Capital (lead); Kleiner Perkins; GV; Titanium Ventures; M12; Wipro Ventures | $30M | - | Incorta, a Californian analytics platform founded in 2013 by…Incorta, a Californian analytics platform founded in 2013 by former Oracle executives, raised $30 million in an August 15, 2019 Series C funding round led by Sorenson Capital, with participation from GV, Kleiner Perkins, M12, Telstra Ventures, and Ron Wohl, bringing total funding to $75 million. The company develops an ETL-free data processing solution using Direct Data Mapping to enable real-time data analytics, targeting businesses struggling with traditional data warehouses for faster access to complex data volumes. Customers at the time included Starbucks, Shutterfly, and Broadcom.
Incorta reported 284% year-over-year revenue growth around the round, attributed to new industry partnerships and product innovation. The company had recently hired 200 new employees over the prior six months, reaching about 250 total, and expanded with offices in Chicago, Dubai, and Bangalore.
Funding proceeds were allocated to further hiring, product investment in its Direct Data Mapping system, and deepening ties with major public cloud providers to capitalize on demand for disruptive data warehousing alternatives. Investors highlighted Incorta's potential to upend the mature data warehousing market dominated by slow infrastructure. Subsequent rounds included a $120 million Series D in June 2021 with similar investors plus others like Prysm Capital and National Grid Partners, and total funding reached approximately $193-199 million across 10 rounds by 2021-2025. | | Oct 2018 | Series B | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fm12.vc&size=64)M12,![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fti.vc&size=64)Titanium VenturesM12 (lead); Titanium Ventures (lead) | $15M | - | - | | Sep 2017 | Series B | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kleinerperkins.com&size=64)Kleiner Perkins,![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.gv.com&size=64)GV +1Kleiner Perkins (lead); GV; Ron Wohl | $15M | - | Incorta is a real-time data analytics startup that eliminate…Incorta is a real-time data analytics startup that eliminates the need for data warehouses using its Direct Data Mapping engine to map data straight from enterprise software and applications, providing near real-time insights for massive datasets. Customers at the time included Broadcom, StitchFix, and Toast. The company raised a $15 million Series B round on September 19, 2017, led by Kleiner Perkins with participation from GV and Ron Wohl, bringing total funding to $25 million following a $10 million Series A led by GV in May 2016. Kleiner Perkins general partner Ted Schlein joined the board. Funds were allocated to accelerate product development, expand sales operations internationally, and develop features for a cloud marketplace enabling partners to build vertical applications and AI modules. | | Mar 2017 | Series A | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.gv.com&size=64)GV,![](data:image/svg+xml,)Ron WohlGV (lead); Ron Wohl | $10M | - | Incorta is a real-time analytics platform that eliminates th…Incorta is a real-time analytics platform that eliminates the need for data warehouses by using a Direct Data Mapping Engine to map data directly from sources, reducing query times from hours to seconds and enabling secure, sub-second insights at massive scale. Incorporated in 2013 or 2014, the company targets enterprises in regulated industries with its privacy-conscious approach that preserves source system security rules.
GV led Incorta's $10 million Series A round announced around March 1, 2017, bringing total funding past $22 million including prior $2.6 million in equity and debt. Ron Wohl, a private investor and former Oracle executive, also participated and joined the board alongside GV's Karim Faris. The funding supported sales, marketing, and accelerated product development.
Early customers included Broadcom, Henkel, Stitch Fix, Toast, and an undisclosed top consumer electronics or Fortune 10 manufacturing company. Incorta later raised additional rounds, including a $15 million Series B in September 2017 led by Kleiner Perkins with GV and Ron Wohl participating, and a $120 million Series D in 2021 led by Prysm Capital with GV and others, reaching $195 million total funding. | | Sep 2015 | Seed | - | $2M | $8M | Incorta raised $514,541.80 in a Series Seed round on Septemb…Incorta raised $514,541.80 in a Series Seed round on September 14, 2015, achieving a post-money valuation of $7.89 million. The round was from undisclosed investors, marking an early funding stage for the data analytics company founded in 2013. This seed investment followed closely after the company's inception and preceded larger subsequent rounds.
Incorta develops an ETL-free data processing solution, targeting inefficiencies in traditional data warehousing. The platform enables real-time data analytics, serving customers like Starbucks, Shutterfly, and Broadcom in later years. By 2019, the company reported 284% year-over-year revenue growth, though specific figures were not disclosed.
The 2015 seed round contributed to Incorta's funding trajectory, with total capital raised reaching over $199 million by 2025 and a valuation of $507.3 million as of April 2025. Later rounds included a $30 million Series C in 2019 led by Sorenson Capital and a $120 million Series D in 2021. | Incorta funding rounds ### Who has invested in Incorta? 10 investors have backed Incorta across its funding rounds, including GV, Kleiner Perkins, M12, Titanium Ventures, Ron Wohl and Sorenson Capital.
